gloss: to surge; to crowd in; to press forward

definitions.gloss: to surge; to rush in; to press forward
definitions.explanation: To move forward in a mass or with force, like waves or a crowd.
For people or things to gather or arrive in large numbers.

examples.japanese: {大波|おおなみ}が{岸|きし}に{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる。
examples.english: Large waves surge toward the shore.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}がステージに{押|お}し{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: The audience surged toward the stage.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}が{押|お}し{寄|よ}せて{対応|たいおう}しきれない。
examples.english: Orders are flooding in and we can't keep up.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる → {押|お}し{寄|よ}せない (negative)
・{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる → {押|お}し{寄|よ}せて (te-form)
・{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる → {押|お}し{寄|よ}せた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {押|お}す (to push) + {寄|よ}せる (to bring near)

USAGE:
Often used to describe:
・{波|なみ}が{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (waves surging)
・{群衆|ぐんしゅう}が{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (crowd pressing in)
・{問|と}い{合|あ}わせが{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (inquiries flooding in)
・{不安|ふあん}が{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (anxiety welling up)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{殺到|さっとう}する - to rush in, to flood (more intense)
